title: v2 agent semantic data dictionary — field-mappings.json
description: Format of contracts/data-dictionary/field-mappings.json: a schema_registry mapping each v2 document's JSON pointers (or, for the multipart backup submission, its flat part names) to a semantic-model.json concept id (FR-038, D15).

schema_registry.description: document/schema id -> map of pointer -> semantic id

additionalProperties.description: JSON pointer (RFC 6901), or a flat /part_name for the multipart backup submission, mapped to a semantic-model.json concept id
must resolve to a key present in semantic-model.json — enforced by tools/check_data_dictionary.py, not by this schema alone
